dataset_meta.name: Ownership Model Data
dataset_meta.description: Global equity ownership by institutions, mutual funds and insiders/stakeholders; position-level holdings from regulatory filings (SEC 13F, UK Share Register and other international disclosures). Tracks current and historical positions, market values and investment styles; enables analysis of ownership trends, concentration and changes over time.
dataset_meta.update_frequency_note: Ownership filings are periodic (quarterly-style reporting); cur_* / pre_* are current vs previous reported position levels. Between filings the raw level is a step function, so state-freeze / event-gate mechanisms are economically motivated.

inst18_fundownershipv2_vm_erp.description: Previous market value of shares held by the fund
inst18_fundownershipv2_vm_erp.semantic_provenance: live data-fields API (id/description/type/coverage/userCount/alphaCount); domain/skewness/role inferred from physical meaning

inst18_fundownershipv2_pre_holding.description: Previous number of shares held by the fund
inst18_fundownershipv2_pre_holding.semantic_provenance: live data-fields API; domain inferred from non-negative share counts

inst18_fundownershipv2_cur_mv.description: Current market value of shares held by the fund
inst18_fundownershipv2_cur_mv.semantic_provenance: live data-fields API; domain inferred from non-negative market value

inst18_fundownershipv2_num_held.description: Number of shareholding positions (distinct funds or entities) reported for the security

inst18_fundownershipv2_pct_held.description: Current percentage of outstanding shares held by the fund
